detail.name: Porcelume Plate Decor: Upright and Principled
detail.desc: A Porcelume plate fired from Lumite ore with refined fire essence, a Waifei Peninsula cultural specialty certified by Buyan. They say that keeping one of these plates at home lends a touch of noble grace to the words and manners of everyone under that roof.
